narrative.overview: An editorial portfolio built like a ledger: one ink on one paper, a 12-column page, and hairline rules that record where every block begins and ends. The type does the loud work while the interface stays quiet. The palette never gains a third color; light and dark are the same pair inverted, and the only other colors live inside the drawn product screens of the works. Square corners, 1px rules and flat surfaces keep the page close to a printed sheet. The work leads: the hero is the name and the portrait, the works take the full screen, the services take the full width, and the contact section and footer close without repeating what has been said.
keyCharacteristics: One ink/surface pair, inverted for dark mode
4/12 columns on mobile, 12 on desktop, 10-column inset reading frame
Oversized Space Grotesk display type with tight tracking
Full-bleed works and service rows; hairline rules elsewhere
Square corners; only the works traffic lights are round
Drawn product screens instead of stock imagery

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every color in the interface is the ink, the surface, or a mix of the two. The only other colors allowed are inside a drawn product screen, where they belong to that product.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: One oversized display word per section. It names the section; the body copy and labels never compete with it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is flat until it is a product screen. If a block needs to stand out, invert it; do not add a shadow.

dos: Do keep the palette to the ink/surface pair and their mixes; the works' product screens are the only exception.
Do use 1px hairline rules to hold the grid; use strong hairline for controls and section edges.
Do keep corners square and surfaces flat.
Do set labels in uppercase at 0.65–0.7rem with 0.18em tracking.
Do let the works and the service rows break the inset frame to the full width.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: no marquee, no entrance travel, no theme travel, no label roll.
Do say each thing once; the section list is in the header/menu, the contact links in the footer/menu.
donts: Don't add a second accent color, gradients or decorative glows to the chrome.
Don't round cards, buttons or inputs; the traffic lights of the works frame are the only circles.
Don't put a shadow on a card, a button or a section; invert the block instead.
Don't repeat contact details in the contact section, the footer and the menu.
Don't invent clients, testimonials, metrics or case studies; the evidence is the public GitHub account and the site's own copy.
Don't make the interface the subject; the work, the type and the grid are.
